Headers of ONNX Runtime v1.32.0 (include/onnxruntime/core/session from github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime,
tag v1.32.0, MIT licence), matching the libonnxruntime.so.1.32.0 shipped in the onnxruntime-gpu wheel
of the ML environment. The C++ runtime links that library; nothing else from ORT is vendored.
